newsitem.title: USA: Collins & Aikman completes JPS notes buyback.
newsitem.headline: Collins & Aikman completes JPS notes buyback.

text.p: Collins & Aikman Corp said that the offer by its wholly owned units, JPS Automotive Products Corp and JPS Automotive LP to repurchase the 11-1/8 percent senior notes due 2001 of JPS Automotive expired at the close of business on March 5.

About $3.9 million principal amount of the notes (subject to final verification with the Trustee) were tendered to JPS Automotive in the offer and, after such notes are repurchased by JPS Automotive, about $108 million principal amount of the notes will remain outstanding.
